name: ffi_status
summary: Returns a mapping of live-handle counts for introspection and leak checks, with integer values under the keys "libraries" (open ffi_load() handles), "functions" (prepared ffi_prepare() handles), and "callbacks" (live ffi_callback() closures).

availability.condition: 需要 PACKAGE_FFI 和 libffi；WebAssembly 目标不可用
